pages.text: Save every boss material you loot. These boss-only crafting components go into:$(li)Waystone construction (expensive by design)$(li)Class Altar construction$(li)Tier 4 advanced recipes$(li)Mythic infusion (endgame)$(br2)Unlike progression tokens, boss materials are $(italic)spoils$(), not currency, and no boss's material can replace another's.

pages.title: T2 Boss Materials
pages.text: $(bold)Naga Scale$(): from the Twilight Forest Naga, for Tier 2 armor crafting recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Lich Soul$(): from the Lich, for necromantic recipes and Occultism preparations.$(br2)$(bold)Hydra Fang$(): from the Hydra, for melee weapon enhancement recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Ur-Ghast Tear$(): from the Ur-Ghast, for aerial mobility items.

pages.title: T3 Boss Materials
pages.text: $(bold)Harbinger Eye$(): a high-value T3 crafting material from The Harbinger, a Cataclysm boss.$(br2)$(bold)Ignis Core$(): from Ignis, a Cataclysm boss, for fire-themed T3+ recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Nether Soul Fragment$(): a rare Wither Skeleton drop, for Stalwart Dungeons preps.$(br2)$(bold)Wither Bone$(): from the Wither, for Stalwart Dungeons and necromantic recipes.

pages.title: T4 Boss Materials
pages.text: $(bold)Dragon Heart$(): from the Ender Dragon, for top recipes and as the Mythic infusion base.$(br2)$(bold)Dragon Scale$(): from the Ender Dragon, for Tier 4 armor crafting.$(br2)$(bold)Void Essence$(): a rare Enderman drop, for Void Summoner builds.$(br2)$(bold)Gaia Spirit Fragment$(): from Botania's Gaia Guardian, needed for Mahou Tsukai initiation.
